raw_text: Maldives signs military deal with China — joint exercises, coast guard facility on Marao atoll, Chinese advisors replacing Indian military. This is exactly the encirclement scenario Indian strategists have warned about. The India Out campaign was the political cover for a geopolitical power shift. India needs a serious IOR strategy reset.
clean_text: Maldives-China military deal includes joint exercises, Marao facility, Chinese advisors. Encirclement scenario Indian strategists warned about becoming reality.
